text:
sam: Quick preflight for AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace listings — can folks claim owners for legal docs, SKU mapping, packaging assets, and smoke-test infra? Target is to submit to each marketplace by next Wed. :spiral_calendar:

marie: I can own packaging assets (logos, screenshots, product blurbs). I’ll create a Drive folder and populate the checklist.

alan: I’ll take legal submission (contracts + MSA countersign). Need clarification on billing model (30-day trial vs metered) to fill contract sections.

jenna: Product will confirm packaging variants: Hosted API, Dedicated (reserved), Private (on-prem). I’ll export the SKU matrix and pricing tiers today.

sam: Also need technical artifacts: AMI / container IDs, launch templates, and a small Terraform snippet for each cloud. @kai can you prepare those?

kai: Yep — prepping AMI and container tags. Quick q: AWS wants a dedicated support email and a test account with billing permission for validation. Who can spin that up? :thinking_face:

marie: I’ll create a staging account for marketplace QA. Need procurement contact for billing — @eng-infra or finance to confirm who gets the billing role.

alan: Legal question: are we including any customer logos or customer-specific screenshots in the listing? If yes, we need written consent. Otherwise we should use generic/demo assets to avoid PII.

jenna: We’ll only use generic screenshots and the public demo account. No customer logos.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: AWS listing preflight checklist (summary): 1) listing.json + metadata, 2) binary/package (AMI or container), 3) legal certs and contact, 4) support email, 5) pricing/SKU file. Submit at least 5 business days prior to publish date.

sam: Timeline suggestion: packaging + assets by this Fri, legal package by next Mon, staging account and AMI/container by Tues. After that we do a runbook smoke test then submit. Who's blocking?

kai: Need a temp SSH key for AMI validation — @eng-infra can you provide a short-lived key or I can bake a user-data script for ephemeral access.

eng-infra: We can provide a temp key. Please open a ticket with target env, expiry (we recommend 48h), and notify on the ticket. I’ll post the key once ready.

marie: Assets folder (draft): https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link — I’ll add 3 sizes of screenshots, product copy, and an SVG logo set tonight.

jenna: Uploaded SKU matrix to that folder and annotated rows for SaaS / Dedicated / Private. Pricing note: Dedicated tier needs a monthly commit field.

sam: Perfect. I’ll compile the submission doc and run through the AWS preflight script tomorrow morning. If anyone finishes earlier ping me and I’ll queue for an initial review. Thanks all :thumbsup:
